cashRoundingNote: Was "floor-cent", and this board's own committed capture refutes that. "floor-cent" is the claim that cash = FLOOR(basis + futures), so a residual is never negative, and this board carries a negative residual. "round-cent-either" explains every row and is the narrowest mode that does, by a margin of 3 row(s) over the nearest rival.
